game.mishana.title: Mish Ana!
game.mishana.howto.1: Everyone gets the same word, except the Mole, who gets none…
game.mishana.howto.2: Give one clue each, out loud.
game.mishana.howto.4: The Mole gets one last guess.
game.mishana.rules.goal.title: The goal
game.mishana.rules.goal.body: Civilians: find the infiltrators and vote them out. Infiltrators: blend in and survive.
game.mishana.rules.roles.title: The roles
game.mishana.rules.roles.body: Civilians share the same word. The Undercover has a slightly different word and doesn't know it. The Mole has no word at all.
game.mishana.rules.words.title: Your secret word
game.mishana.rules.words.body: Hold the card on your phone to see your word. Never show it to anyone.
game.mishana.rules.clues.title: Clues
game.mishana.rules.clues.body: One by one, say one word or a short phrase about your word, out loud. Don't say the word itself.
game.mishana.rules.vote.title: Voting
game.mishana.rules.vote.body: Everyone votes on their phone for the player they suspect. The player with the most votes is out, and their role is revealed.
game.mishana.rules.tie.title: Ties
game.mishana.rules.tie.body: If the vote is tied, the tied players give one more clue each, then everyone votes again between them only.
game.mishana.rules.guess.title: The Mole's last chance
game.mishana.rules.guess.body: A Mole who is voted out gets one guess at the Civilians' word. A right guess wins the game for the Mole.
game.mishana.rules.points.title: Points
game.mishana.rules.points.body: By default, each winning Civilian scores 2 points, and a winning Undercover or Mole scores 10. Scores add up when you play again.
